mil7.7.7:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, maṇiratanassa tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.7.7:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena ekantaparisuddhājīvena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.7.7:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja maṇiratanassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.7:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja maṇiratanaṃ na kenaci saddhiṃ missīyati,
mil7.7.7:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena pāpehi pāpasahāyehi saddhiṃ na missitabbaṃ.
mil7.7.7:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja maṇiratanassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.7:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja maṇiratanaṃ jātiratanehi yojīyati,
mil7.7.7:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena uttamavarajātimantehi saddhiṃ saṃvasitabbaṃ, paṭipannakaphalaṭṭha-sekhaphalasamangīhi sotāpanna-sakadāgāmianāgāmi-arahanta-tevijja-chaḷabhiñña-samaṇa-maṇiratanehi saddhiṃ saṃvasitabbaṃ.
mil7.7.7:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja maṇiratanassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.7:3.4: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena Suttanipāte:
